g.text: No load switch or hold-up reservoir; SD_POWER_EN is reserved. All card pull-ups use the shared 3V3 rail.

g.desc: No load switch or hold-up reservoir; SD_POWER_EN is reserved. All card pull-ups use the shared 3V3 rail.

g.text: BAT_WARN_OK low: stop capture, drain queue, wait for card ready, sync best effort. No guaranteed flush interval.

g.desc: BAT_WARN_OK low: stop capture, drain queue, wait for card ready, sync best effort. No guaranteed flush interval.

g.text: Switch to GND, 10k pull-up and 100R/10 nF filter to SD_DETECT_N; software debounce.

g.desc: Switch to GND, 10k pull-up and 100R/10 nF filter to SD_DETECT_N; software debounce.

g.text: 33R damping between module and card; 100k keeps SCLK low at reset.

g.desc: 33R damping between module and card; 100k keeps SCLK low at reset.

g.text: DM3AT socket on the shared 3V3 rail; 22 uF bulk plus 100 nF. Remove the card only with power off.

g.desc: DM3AT socket on the shared 3V3 rail; 22 uF bulk plus 100 nF. Remove the card only with power off.
